author: Dear_Madelene
body:
**Star Seeker X** is my favorite title because it was the hardest to obtain - in my time-zone towers reach 50 floors only in 3 am, so I had to wait until a tower spawn near me, then set an alarm for this time on a day I knew it will reach 50 floors, and then I had to speedrun this bad boy in a half asleep state.

But I did it, and I will never do this again, lol

Also it was before the movement update, so I didn't have the time to find chests and did all that almost without any buffs.
